title: Rams’ Myles Garrett, Sean McVay react to Aaron Donald comeback rumors

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams’ Myles Garrett, Sean McVay react to Aaron Donald comeback rumors
sources.description: Aaron Donald's potential return to the Los Angeles Rams is fueling NFL speculation. Sean McVay left the door open, while Myles Garrett's reaction spoke volumes as rumors of a blockbuster comeback continue to grow.
